name: the-last-mile
description: The Last Mile: get your app out of your laptop and into the App Store and Google Play, on any stack.

plugins.name: the-last-mile
plugins.description: /ship takes any mobile app to the App Store and Google Play: rejection sweep against sourced store traps, release build, store listing, upload and submit. Plus skills for the days between releases: setup, session end, seeing changes work, design references, research, goals, porting features, fact checking, and improving skills from the projects that use them.
